name: Peace
momentumNotes: Heaven and earth are in communication; the current supports growth, exchange, and ease.
theme: Peace arrives when heaven and earth move toward one another. Inner clarity and outer receptivity can meet in an easy, living flow.
basicInterpretation: Receive the openness of this moment without becoming careless. When things move well, tend the conditions that allow harmony to continue.
reflectionPrompt: What relationship or pattern is ready to breathe more freely?

reversed.theme: Flipped upside down, Peace becomes Hexagram 12, Standstill. This other side brings in the atmosphere of stagnation, separation, preservation, asking how the situation may look from another threshold.
reversed.reflection: Let Standstill widen the reading rather than replace it. Consider what another person, timing, or hidden part of you might see when the pattern is viewed from the far side.
reversed.applicationPrompt: Visualize your question from the far side, as if another person or your future self is looking back through Standstill. Notice where stagnation, separation, preservation and a blocked, declining movement reveal needs, timing, or motives that the first view may miss.

opposite.theme: The contrast to Peace is Hexagram 12, Standstill. Where the primary pattern emphasizes harmony, flow, prosperity, this complementary field points toward stagnation, separation, preservation.
opposite.reflection: This is not the main movement of the reading, but it shows what balances or challenges it. It can also highlight hidden causes or contrasting forces at play. Notice where Standstill names the medicine, shadow, or unchosen path beside the situation.
opposite.applicationPrompt: Visualize Standstill as the contrasting color laid beside Peace. Ask what hidden cause, missing medicine, or opposing pressure is suggested by stagnation, separation, preservation, especially where the situation carries a challenging, restrained tone.
